senses.gloss: वि-तत्करण and -तद्भाषण, see अ-वि-त्˚.
वि-तत्करण and -तद्भाषण, see अ-वि-त्˚.
वि-तद्-भाषण See अ-वित्˚.
वि—तथ See s.v.
वि-तथ mf(आ)n. (fr. वि + तथा, not so) untrue, false, incorrect, unreal, vain, futile (instr. ‘falsely’; ˚थं-√ कृ, ‘to revoke, annul’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
free from (abl.), Āpast.
वि-तथ m. N. of Bharad-vāja, Hariv.
of a partic. class of domestic deities, VarBṛS.; Hcat.
वि॑—तनु (वि॑-), mf(वी)n. extremely thin or slender, MBh.
bodiless, Kāvyād.
having no essence or reality, TS.
वि॑—तनु m. the god of love (cf. अनङ्ग), Gīt.
वि—तन्तु m. a good horse, W.
वि—तन्तु f. a widow, ib.
वि—तन्त्री f. (nom. ईस्) a string out of tune, Kum.
वि—तमस् mfn. free from darkness, light, MBh.; Ragh.
वि-तमस् See p. 950, col. 3.
वि—तमस्क mfn. id., MBh.; VarBṛS.
वि—तमस्क—ता f., Jātakam.
exempt from the quality of ignorance, MW.
वि—तरम् See s.v.
वि-तर॑म् ind. (fr. 3. वि + तरम्) farther, farther off, more distant (either in space or time), more, RV.
वि-˚तरा॑म् id., ŚBr.; ĀpŚr.
वि—तल n. N. of one of the seven hells, ĀruṇUp.; BhP. (cf. पाताल)
depth of hell, Bālar.
वि—ताल mfn. (in music) breaking time, Saṃgīt.
वि—ताल m. wrong time or measure, Nalac.
वि—तल—लोक m. the world or lower region of Vitala, MW.
1. वि—तान mfn. (for 2. See under वि-√ तन्) ‘out of tune’, dejected, sad, Ragh. vi, 86
empty, Harav. (also in अव्˚, Śiś. iii, 50)
dull, stupid, W.
wicked, abandoned, ib.
2. वि-तान m. n. (for 1. See p. 950, col. 3) extension, great extent or quantity, mass, heap, plenty, abundance, Kāv.; VarBṛS.
high degree, Bhartṛ.
manifoldness, variety, Gīt.
performance, accomplishment, development, growth, BhP.
an oblation, sacrifice, MBh.; Śiś.; BhP.
an awning, canopy, cover, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the separate arrangement of the three sacred fires or the separate fires themselves, GṛŚrS.
वि-तान m. or n. (?) a partic. bandage for the head, Suśr.
वि-तान n. N. of a partic. metre or of a class of metres, Piṅg., Sch.; Col.
leisure, opportunity, L.
वि-तान &c. See p. 962, col. 3.
वि-तन See आहर-वितना.
वि-ताना f. N. of the wife of Sattrāyaṇa, BhP.
वीतन m. du. (possibly fr. वि + √ तन्) the sides or cartilages of the larynx or throat, L.
1. वि—ता˚नी-भूत mfn. being sad or dejected, Jātakam.
वि—तामस mfn. = -तमस्, Kathās.
वि-तामस , वि-तार. See p. 950, col. 3.
वि—तार mfn. starless, Ghaṭ.
without a nucleus (as a comet), VarBṛS.
वि॑-तर mfn. leading further away (as a path), ŚBr.
वि—ताली f. an instrument for beating time, L.
वि—तिमिर mfn. = -तमस्, MBh.; R. &c.
वि—तिलक mfn. having no sectarian mark (on the forehead), BhP.
वि—तुङ्ग-भाग mfn. not being on the highest point, VarBṛS.
वि—तुष mfn. unhusked, Gobh.
वि-तुष &c. See p. 950, col. 3.
वि—तु˚षी-करण n. unhusking, Nyāyam., Sch.
वि—तु˚षी-√ कृ P. -करोति, to unhusk, ŚBr.
वि—तुष्ट mfn. displeased, dissatisfied, Pañcar.
वि—तृण mfn. grassless, Bhaṭṭ.
वि-तृण , वि-तृतीय &c. See p. 950, col. 3.
वि-तृण्ण mfn. pierced, cleft &c., ŚBr.
वि—तृतीय॑ mfn. intermittent on the third day (said of a kind of fever), AV.
वि—तृतीय॑ n. a third, ŚBr.
वि—तृष् or वि—तृष, mfn. free from thirst, BhP.

1. वि-√ तृष् P. -तृष्यति, to be thirsty, VS.; TS.; Kāṭh. :
Caus. -तर्षयति (aor. -तीतृषत्), to make thirsty, cause to thirst, TS.; Kāṭh.
2. वि-तृष् &c. See p. 950, col. 3.
वि—तृष् or वि—तृष, mfn. free from thirst, BhP.
वि—तृष्ण mf(आ)n. id., MBh.
free from desire, not desirous of (comp.), BhP.
वि—तृष्णा f. = next, BhP. (cf. under वि-√ तृष्)
वि-˚तृष्णा f. (cf. p. 950, col. 3) thirst for, ardent desire, BhP.
N. of a river, VP.
वि—तृष्ण—ता f. freedom from desire, satiety, Kāv.
वि—तृष्ण—त्व n. freedom from desire, satiety, Kāv.
वि—तोय mf(आ)n. waterless, Hariv.
वि—त्रप m. ‘shameless’, N. of a man, Rājat.
वि-तंस m. (√ तंस्) any net or chain or apparatus for catching and confining beasts and birds, L. (cf. वी-त्˚; अव-त्˚ and उत्-तंस).
वी-तंस m. (fr. 1. वि + त्˚; cf. वि-त्˚) a cage or net or any enclosure for catching or confining or keeping birds or beasts, Hcar.
वि-√ तक्ष् P. -तक्षति, to cut off, cleave or split in pieces, RV.
वि॑-तष्ट mfn. hewn or carved out, planed, fashioned, ŚBr.
वि॑-तष्ट See col. 2.
वि-तण्ड m. (prob. connected with prec.) a sort of lock or bolt with three divisions or wards, W.
an elephant, ib.

वि-तण्डा f. cavil, captious objection, fallacious controversy, perverse or frivolous argument (esp. in Nyāya, ‘idly carping at the arguments or assertions of another without attempting to prove the opposite side of the question’, cf. IW. 64), Nyāyas. (-त्व n. Sch.), Sarvad.; MBh. &c.
criticism, W.
a ladle, spoon, L.
Arum Colocasia, L.
= करवीरी, L.
= शिलाह्वय, L.
वि-तण्डा—त्व n., Sch.
वि-तण्डक m. N. of an author (-स्मृति f. his wk.)
वि-तण्डक—स्मृति f., wk. by वितण्डक
वि॑-तत &c. See below.
वि॑-तत mfn. spread out, extended &c.
diffused, drawn (as a bow-string), RV.
bent (as a bow), R.
covered, filled, Hariv.
prepared (as a road), AV.
extensive, far-spreading, broad, wide (अम् ind.), VS. &c. &c.
वि॑-तत n. any stringed instrument (such as a lute &c.), L.
वि-तथ—ता f. untruth, falsehood (acc. with √ गम्, ‘to become a lie’), Hariv.
वि-तथ—प्रयत्न mfn. one whose efforts are futile or in vain, Ragh.
वि-तथ—मर्याद mfn. incorrect in behaviour, MBh.
वि-तथ—वाच् mfn. (Siṃhās.) speaking a falsehood, lying
वि-तथ—वादिन् mfn. (Kathās.) speaking a falsehood, lying
वि-त˚थाभिनिवेश m. inclination to falsehood, Mn.; Yājñ. (-वत् mfn. prone to falsehood, Yājñ. iii, 135)
वि-त˚थाभिनिवेश—वत् mfn., prone to falsehood, Yājñ. iii, 135
वि-त˚थ्य mfn. untrue, MW.
वितथय Nom. P. ˚यति, to render untrue, accuse of falsehood, Śiś.

वितथी-√ कृ P. -करोति, to render vain or futile, MBh.; Kum.;
to remove, expel, Dharmaś.
वितद्रु f. N. of a river, Uṇ. iv, 102, Sch.
वि॑-ततम् ind.
वि-तत—त्व n. extendedness, expansiveness, largeness, Hariv.; Pur.
वि-तत—धन्वन् mfn. one who has drawn a bow to its full stretch, MBh.
वि-तत—वपुस् mfn. having an elongated body, MW.
वि॑-त˚ताध्वर (वि॑-), mfn. one who has prepared a sacrifice, ŚBr.
वि-त˚तायुध mfn. = वितत-धन्वन्, MBh.
वि-त˚तोत्सव mfn. one who has arranged a festival, Kathās.
वि-तति f. extent, length, BhP.
spreading, extension, expansion, diffusion, ib.
excess, Kāv.
quantity, collection, cluster, clump (of trees &c.), Kir.
वितती, in comp. for वि-तत.
वितती—करणा f. spreading, W.
वितती—√ कृ P. -करोति (pp. -कृत), to stretch out, expand, Naiṣ.
वि-तत्य Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to stretch, expand, be diffused, ĀpŚr.
वि-तनितृ mfn. one who spreads or extends, BhP.
वि-तान—कल्प m. N. of a Pariśiṣṭa belonging to the Atharva-veda, Caraṇ.
वि-तान—मूलक n. the root of Andropogon Muricatus, L.
वि-तान—वत् mfn. having a canopy or awning, Kum.
वि-˚तानक m. n. an awning, canopy, covering, (esp.) a cloth spread over a large open hall or court (in which dancing, singing &c. are exhibited), R.; Kathās.
quantity, mass, Śiś.
an expanse, W.
Caryota Urens, L.
वितानाय Nom. (only Pass. ˚य्यते impers.) to represent an awning or canopy, Mālatīm.
वितानी in comp. for वि-तान.
वितानी—√ कृ P. -करोति (pp. -कृत), to spread or extend over (as a canopy &c.), overshadow, MW.
वितानी—√ भू P. -भवति, to represent a canopy, Bālar.
वितन्तसा॑य्य mfn. to be shaken or set in violent motion, RV.
वि-तरण &c. See under वि-√ तॄ.
वि-˚तरण mfn. one who crosses or passes over, MBh.
वि-˚तरण n. the act of crossing or passing over, MW.
leading over, transference, Suśr. : granting, bestowal, donation, gift, Inscr.; Kāv.

वि-√ तर्क् P. -तर्कयति, to reflect, ponder, think, believe, suppose, conjecture, consider as or take for (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.;
to find out, ascertain, Kathās.
वि-˚तर्क m. conjecture, supposition, guess, fancy, imagination, opinion, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
doubt, uncertainty, Yogas.; Sarvad.
a dubious or questionable matter, Yogas.
reasoning, deliberation, consideration, Kāv.; Sāh.
purpose, intention, Jātakam.
a teacher, instructor in divine knowledge, W.
a partic. class of Yogīs, Jātakam.
N. of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, MBh.
pl. N. of the five principal sins, Jātakam.
वि-˚तर्क—पदवी f. the path of conjecture or supposition, Prab.
वि-˚तर्क—वत् mfn. (speech) containing a c˚ or s˚, Daśar.
वि-˚तर्कण n. reasoning, conjecture, doubt, L.
वि-˚तर्कित See अ-वितर्कित.
वि-˚तर्क्य mfn. to be considered, questionable, doubtful, BhP.

वि-तर्दि or वि-तर्दिका, f. (said to be fr. √ तृद्) a raised and covered piece of ground in the centre of a house or temple or in the middle of a courtyard, verandah, balcony &c., R.; Rājat. (L. also ˚तर्दी, ˚तर्द्धी or ˚तर्द्धि and ˚तर्द्धिका)

वि-तर्दि or वि-तर्दिका, f. (said to be fr. √ तृद्) a raised and covered piece of ground in the centre of a house or temple or in the middle of a courtyard, verandah, balcony &c., R.; Rājat. (L. also ˚तर्दी, ˚तर्द्धी or ˚तर्द्धि and ˚तर्द्धिका)
वि-तस्त mfn. (said to be fr. √ तंस्, or तस्) = उप-क्षीण, Nir. iii, 21, Sch.
वि-तस्ता f. See below
वि-त॑स्ता f. N. of a river in the Panjāb (now called Jhelum or Bitasta or Bihat = the Hydaspes or Bidaspes [Ptolemy] of the Greeks; it rises in Kaśmīr; cf. पञ्च-नद), RV.; MBh. &c. (-त्व n., Rājat.)
= वि-तस्ति (in त्रि-वितस्त॑, q.v.)
वि-तस्त—दत्त m. (for वितस्ता-द्˚ cf. Pāṇ. iv, 3, 63) N. of a merchant, Kathās.
वि-तस्˚ताद्रि m. N. of a mountain, Rājat.
वि-तस्˚ताख्य n. N. of the habitation of the serpent-demon Takṣaka in Kaśmīra, Rājat.
वि-तस्ता—त्व n., Rājat.
वि-तस्ता—पुरी f. N. of a town, Cat.
वि-तस्ता—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.

वि॑-तस्ति f. (once in Hcat. m.; prob. fr. √ तन्) a partic. measure of length (defined either as a long span between the extended thumb and little finger, or as the distance between the wrist and the tip of the fingers, and said to = 12 Aṅgulas or about 9 inches), ŚBr.; GṛŚrS. &c.
वि-तस्ति—देश्य mfn. almost a Vitasti long, Rājat.
विति f. = वीति, in गौ॑री-विति, q.v.
1. वित्ति f. consciousness, Sarvad.
understanding, intelligence, SaṃhitUp.
2. वि॑त्ति f. finding, acquisition, gain, ŚBr.; ChUp.; GṛŚrS.
a find, AitBr.
the being found, existence, L.
(ifc.) a term of praise g. मतल्लिकादि.
1. वीति॑ f. (dat. वीत॑ये often used as inf.) enjoyment, feast, dainty meal, full draught &c., RV.
advantage, profit, ib. (L. also light, lustre = गति, प्रजन, धावन)
वीति॑ m. a partic. Agni, AitBr.
2. वीति॑ f. separation, TS.
3. वीति m. = 1. पीति, a horse, Rājat.
वि-ति॑रे, वि-तीर्ण. See वि-√ तॄ.
वि-˚तु॑द m. N. of a partic. spectral being, TĀr.
वि-तुन्न mfn. pierced, torn &c., MBh.
वि-तुन्न n. Marsilea Quadrifolia, L.
Blyxa Octandra, L.
वि-तुन्ना f. Flacourtia Cataphracta, L.
वि-˚तुन्नक mf(इका)n. Flacourtia Cataphracta, Car.
वि-˚तुन्नक m. n. coriander, L.
वि-˚तुन्नक m. blue vitriol, L.
वि-˚तुन्नक m. or n. (?) a hole in the ear (for a ring), L.
वितुल m. N. of a prince of the Sauvīras, MBh. (B. विपुल).

वि-तूस्तय Nom. (fr. तूस्त with 3. वि) P. ˚यति, to comb out or smooth (hair), Pāṇ. iii, 1, 21, Sch.;
to free from dust, Uṇ. iii, 86, Sch.

वि-√ तृद् P. Ā. -तृणत्ति, -तृन्त्ते, to pierce, bore, cleave, break asunder, excavate, AV.; KaṭhUp. :
Caus. -तर्दयति id., ŚāṅkhŚr.
वि-√ तृप् P. -तृप्यति, to be satisfied, become satiated with (loc.), BhP.
वि-˚तृप्त mfn. satisfied, satiated, R.
वि-˚तृप्त—काम mfn. See अ-वितृ˚.
वि-˚तृप्तक mfn. satiated with (gen.), MBh. (in अ-वितृ˚).
वि-˚तर˚णाचार्य m. N. of a preceptor, W.
वि-˚तरितृ m. a granter, bestower (with gen.), Bālar.
वि-˚तर्तुर॑म् ind. (fr. Intens.) alternately, RV.
वि-˚तारिन् See अ-वितारिन्.
वि-तीर्ण mfn. one who has penetrated beyond or crossed or passed or gone over or through &c.
remote, distant (-तर mfn. more distant), Nir. viii, 9
given, granted, afforded, bestowed, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
fought (as a battle), Rājat.
forgiven, pardoned, Bhartṛ.
performed, produced, accomplished, Rājat.
subdued, overcome, W.
effaced id.
वि-तीर्ण—तर mfn., more distant
वितोला f. N. of a river, Rājat.
वित्कोटिका (?) f. a kind of game, Divyāv.
वित्त् cl. 10. P. वित्तयति, to abandon, give away, Dhātup. xxxv, 78 (Vop.)
वित्त See under √ 1. विद् &c.
1. वित्त mfn. (for 2. See under √ 3. विद्) known, understood (see comp.)
celebrated, notorious, famous for (comp.), Daś. (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 2, 58).
2. वित्त॑ mfn. (for 1. See p. 963) found, acquired, gained, obtained, possessed, AV.; Br.
caught or seized by (instr. or comp.), Br.; Kauś.
वित्त॑ n. anything found, a find, AitBr.
(in later language also pl.) acquisition, wealth, property, goods, substance, money, power, RV. &c. &c.
the second astrological mansion, VarYogay.
3. वित्त or विन्न, mfn. = विचारित, L.
वित्ता (आ), f. taken, married (as a woman), ŚBr.
1. वीत॑ mfn. gone, approached &c.
desired, liked, loved, pleasant, RV.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
straight, smooth, RV. iv, 2, 11; ix, 97, 17
trained, quiet, Rājat.
वीत॑ n. a wish, desire, TĀr.
the driving or guiding of an elephant (with a goad) &c., Śiś. v, 47.
2. वीत mfn. gone away, departed, disappeared, vanished, lost (often ibc. = free or exempt from, without, -less), Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
3. वीत॑ mfn. covered, hidden, concealed, RV. (cf. कृत्स्न-व्˚)
covered or wrapped in, girt with (instr.), ib.; BhP.
4. वीत mfn. (prob. fr. √ वै; for 1. 2. 3. वीत See under √ 1. 3. 4. वी) worn out, useless, L.
वीत n. a useless horse or elephant, L.
वीत See 3. वीत, p. 1004, col. 2.
वीता (आ), f. a line, row (= राजि), ĀśvGṛ.
वी-त्त mfn. (for वि-दत्त, √ 1. दा), APrāt., Sch. (cf. परी-त्त).
वि-त्यज See अ-वित्यज.

वि-√ त्रस् P. -त्रसति, -त्रस्यति, to tremble, be frightened, MBh.; Kāv. &c.:
Caus. -त्रासयति, to cause to tremble, terrify, Mn.; MBh. &c.
वि-˚त्रस्त mfn. frightened, alarmed, terrified, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
वि-˚त्रस्तक mfn. a little affrighted or intimidated, R.
वि-˚त्रास m. fear, terror, alarm, Kathās.; Suśr.
वि-˚त्रास mfn. = next, Hariv.
वि-˚त्रासन mf(ई)n. terrifying, ib.; R.
वि-˚त्रासन n. the act of terrifying, Car.
वि-˚त्रासयितु-काम mfn. (inf. of Caus. + क्˚) wishing to frighten or terrify, R.
वि-˚त्रासित mfn. (fr. Caus.) caused to tremble, terrified, affrighted, MBh.; R.
वि-˚त्रासित—विहंगम mfn. having (its) birds frightened away, MW.
वि-त्रिभ-लग्नक (prob.) n. = त्रिभोन-लग्न, the highest point of the ecliptic above the horizon, Gol.
वि-√ त्रुड् (for त्रुट्) P. -त्रुड्यति, to scratch, excoriate, skin, KātyŚr., Sch.
वि-त्व॑क्षण mfn. (√ त्वक्ष्) very stout or strong or sturdy, RV. v, 34, 6 (Sāy. = विशेषेण तनू-कर्तृ).
वित्सन m. an ox, bull (= वृषभ), L.
वित्तार्थ m. ‘one who knows the matter’, an expert, L.
1. वित्तक mfn. very famous or renowned, Daś.
2. वित्तक See प्रसाद-व्˚ (for 1. See p. 963).
वीतक n. a vessel for camphor and sandal powder, L.
(in अ-व्˚) = वि-वीत, an inclosed spot of ground, Yājñ. ii, 291.
वित्त—काम mfn. desirous of wealth, covetous, avaricious, MBh.
वीत—काम mfn. free from desire, W.
वित्त—काम्या॑ (˚म्या॑), ind. (instr. f.) from avarice, AV.
वित्त—गोप्तृ m. ‘guardian of w˚’, N. of Kubera, MBh.
वित्त—ज mfn. produced by w˚, Pañcat.
वित्त॑—जानि (वित्त॑-), mfn. one who has taken a wife, married, RV.
वित्त—द m. ‘wealth-giver’, benefactor, W.
वित्त—दा f. N. of one of the Mātṛs attendant on Skanda, MBh.
वित्त—दुग्ध n. ‘milk-wealth’, wealth compared to milk, Hit.
वित्त—ध॑ mfn. ‘w˚-possessing’, rich, VS.
वित्त—नाथ m. ‘lord of wealth’, N. of Kubera, Kathās.
वित्त—निचय m. pl. great wealth, opulence, MārkP.
वित्त—प mf(आ)n. guarding w˚, BhP.
वित्त—प m. N. of Kubera, R.; Hariv.
वित्त—पति m. = -नाथ, Mn.; MBh. &c.
वित्ताप्-पति n. du. the lords of wealth and water (i.e. Kubera and Varuṇa), Mn. v, 96.
